How To Use NGMS

Practical guides in the order you'll need them. Start with Installation if this is a new setup.

Prerequisites

  • Docker + Docker Compose — recommended deployment method
  • PostgreSQL 17 — included in the Compose file below, or use an external instance
  • Media directories — mounted into the container at a path you control
  • An indexer account (Newznab or Torznab-compatible) or a Cardigann-supported source
ℹ
New to the *arr ecosystem? Read Introduction to NGMS first — it explains indexers, quality profiles, and the download flow before you configure anything.
